description: Search Votura for audio walking, cycling, or driving tours near a city or coordinates. Returns tours with name, duration, transport type, stop count, and a link that opens the tour in the Votura app (narrated audio guide), with an App Store / Google Play fallback.

city.description: City or place name to search near, e.g. "Paris", "Rome", "New York"

language.description: Preferred language code, e.g. "en-US", "fr-FR", "de-DE" (optional, defaults to en-US)

latitude.description: Latitude — provide instead of city if you have coordinates

longitude.description: Longitude — provide instead of city if you have coordinates

max_duration_minutes.description: Return only tours shorter than this duration in minutes (optional)

name: search_tours
title: Search Tours
